title: Erasing the final buffer symbol
statement: Let $x,w$ be Boolean words, let $i$ be a natural number with $i\le |x|$, and let $b$ be a Boolean value. One step of the raw strip machine from the configuration in state $1$, with input head at position $i+1$, work tape containing $w$ followed by $b$, work head at position $|w++[b]|-1$, and empty output, yields the configuration in state $2$ if $b$ is true and state $1$ otherwise, with input head still at position $i+1$, work tape containing $w$, work head at position $|w|-1$, and empty output.
